notes: Fresh v3.30 beacon was created in this launch and the worker never reused historical identity.
One role claim returned the exact CREATE_EXISTS 422 signature and was correctly treated as contention.
The worker then won portfolio-chat-canary-served-e2e-v1 G000002 and executed a real Playwright/Chromium verification attempt.
The representative browser could launch but outbound GitHub Pages navigation was blocked by the runtime administrator policy, so served E2E was returned as BOUNDARY rather than PASS.

After the RETURN, the fresh compact frontier exposed compatible work. The next authority CREATE received an explicit connector safety denial; per binding rules it was not retried or diverted, and CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED became terminal.
